label: copy phase of length-3 sequences (outputs 2 and 3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never during original input or on the <DEL> step, and only on repeated inputs (in_first=0). Core: sequences of length L=3, where it is active on ~86% of the copy-phase steps (outputting original tokens 1 and 2); the second copy step (t=5, recall_idx 2) carries the strongest activations, and almost all top examples are L=3. This covers 57% of activation mass but only 35% of active steps. The remainder is weaker, token-dependent firing at specific length/position combos: L=4 at recall_idx 2 (t=6, ~20% rate), and L=9 at recall_idx 2-3 (t=11-12) and the last step (t=17); L=5-8 are nearly silent. Adding these clauses raises mass recall to ~0.86 but drops precision to ~0.14. Inputs i and d are over-represented among activations.
